messages.subject: MSstats to analysis peptide performance
parts:
Hello,

I am working with QConCats and will benefit a lot from obtaining automatic analysis only for peptides using MSstats. If I run the analysis from Skyline, I obtain outputs that correspond to my Concatemers (artificial proteins) containing all my peptides, which does not make sense for my purposes and it is not helpful.
